description: Implementation of the mobility_manager class handling handovers, conditional handovers, and related procedures in a cellular network context, including intra- and inter-cell handover logic, NGAP communication, and UE context management.

classes.name: mobility_manager
classes.description: Class managing UE handovers, conditional handovers, and related procedures within a cellular network.

methods.name: trigger_handover
methods.description: Initiates a handover for a UE from a source PCI to a target PCI.

methods.name: trigger_conditional_handover
methods.description: Prepares and triggers a conditional handover for a UE.

methods.name: handle_conditional_handover
methods.description: Handles the preparation phase of a conditional handover, including validation and context setup.

methods.name: handle_neighbor_better_than_spcell
methods.description: Handles event when a neighbor cell is better than the serving cell, potentially triggering handover.

methods.name: handle_handover
methods.description: Performs the handover process, either intra- or inter-cell.

methods.name: handle_inter_cu_handover
methods.description: Handles inter-CU handover requests, including NGAP signaling.
